id: \bBlue: My name is Blue. My special skill is Pokémon training. That is, leveling them up and making them strong.
en: \bBlue: My name is Blue. My special skill is Pokémon training. That is, leveling them up and making them strong.
it: \bBlue: Mi chiamo Blue. La mia specialità è l'allenamento dei Pokémon. Cioè, farli salire di livello e renderli forti.

id: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Trainer.
en: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Trainer.
it: \bPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Allenatore.

id: \bBlue: You might be strong enough to become a Gym Leader one day. You never know.
en: \bBlue: You might be strong enough to become a Gym Leader one day. You never know.
it: \bBlue: Un giorno potresti essere abbastanza forte da diventare Capopalestra. Non si sa mai.
